chunks: And do not say about those who are killed in the way of Allah that they are dead; rather, they are alive, but you do not perceive.
ai.seo_question: Are martyrs truly dead or alive according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the martyrdom of Imam Husayn (AS), affirming that their life transcends mere physical death to include a conscious, spiritual existence in the Barzakh. The phrase 'but you do not perceive' underscores the limitation of human senses in grasping the metaphysical reality of the martyrs' ongoing communion with the Divine.
